summary: Persist and expose evidence contracts for the Angular acceptance harness. Completes the evidence artifact set with 4 missing record methods (cancellation/restart, repair lineage, output fingerprint, source integrity proof), adds optional acceptance-suite event types, integrates DB-backed persistence for harness fixture runs via existing ArtifactMetadataModel, and exposes retrieval endpoints to enumerate/list harness runs and their evidence. No G01–G09 production services are duplicated. The existing GET /api/v1/operator/acceptance-suite/status from T01 is reused directly.

gaps.description: Missing 4 evidence record methods in RuntimeEvidenceCollector: cancellation/restart evidence, repair lineage, output fingerprint, source integrity proof
Missing acceptance-suite-specific WorkflowEventType entries — existing event types are production-oriented; harness suites need their own event types for auditability

AcceptanceHarnessService.generate_fixture/evaluate_fixture do not record the new evidence types — only fixture_manifest and isolation_evidence are currently written; cancellation, repair lineage, output fingerprint, and source integrity proof are never emitted
Missing endpoint to enumerate harness fixture runs — no way to list completed harness runs or their evidence refs; only GET /status exists which is idle-state

AcceptanceHarnessService uses in-memory idempotency (_idempotency_store dict) instead of DB-backed persistence via StateTransitionService — harness run records are not persisted as MigrationRunModel entries, making them non-recoverable across restarts
Missing cancellation/restart evidence hooks — the cancellable fixture variant and run_acceptance_suite do not record cancellation or restart evidence when a run is interrupted or resumed
Missing repair lineage tracking — AcceptanceHarnessService.evaluate_fixture does not record repair attempt lineage when a fixture fails and is repaired
Missing output fingerprinting — no output checksum/fingerprint is computed after fixture evaluation
Missing source integrity proof — no source integrity verification evidence recorded during fixture generation
Tests for T02 components — new evidence methods, persistence integration, and API endpoints need test coverage

implementation_steps.description: This plan document — read-only planner output

Add optional acceptance-suite event types to WorkflowEventType enum: ACCEPTANCE_SUITE_STARTED, ACCEPTANCE_SUITE_COMPLETED, ACCEPTANCE_SUITE_FAILED, FIXTURE_GENERATED, FIXTURE_GENERATION_FAILED, FIXTURE_EVALUATED, FIXTURE_EVALUATION_FAILED, FIXTURE_CANCELLED, FIXTURE_RESTARTED, OUTPUT_FINGERPRINT_CREATED, SOURCE_INTEGRITY_VERIFIED, REPAIR_LINEAGE_RECORDED. These complete the event coverage for acceptance-suite auditability. Add HarnessRunStatusDto (run_id, suite_id, overall_status, fixture_count, passed, failed, started_at, completed_at, evidence_refs) for the suite retrieval endpoint.

Add 6 new evidence record methods to RuntimeEvidenceCollector:

1. record_cancellation_evidence(run_id, fixture_id, fixture_root, reason, cancel_event_type) → ArtifactRefDto
   - Records the cancellation event metadata, reason, and context as evidence
   - Stores as 00_job_setup/cancellation_evidence_{hash8}.json

2. record_restart_evidence(run_id, fixture_id, fixture_root, restart_context) → ArtifactRefDto
   - Records the restart event metadata including previous evidence refs and state version
   - Stores as 00_job_setup/restart_evidence_{hash8}.json

3. record_repair_lineage(run_id, fixture_id, repair_attempts, repair_artifacts) → ArtifactRefDto
   - Records the full repair lineage: attempt numbers, statuses, diagnosis, applied patches, outcome
   - Stores as 00_job_setup/repair_lineage_{hash8}.json

4. record_output_fingerprint(run_id, fixture_id, artifact_root, fingerprint_data) → ArtifactRefDto
   - Records SHA256 fingerprints of the build output directory structure and content
   - Stores as 00_job_setup/output_fingerprint_{hash8}.json

5. record_source_integrity_proof(run_id, fixture_id, source_path, checksum, manifest) → ArtifactRefDto
   - Records source integrity verification: pre-generation vs post-generation checksum comparison
   - Stores as 00_job_setup/source_integrity_proof_{hash8}.json

6. record_acceptance_suite_evidence(run_id, aggregate_summary, fixture_results) → ArtifactRefDto
   - Records the complete acceptance suite run aggregate as a consolidated evidence artifact
   - Stores as 00_job_setup/acceptance_suite_{hash8}.json

All methods follow the existing _write_and_register pattern: atomic write through LocalFilesystemArtifactStore + ArtifactMetadataModel registration. Each returns ArtifactRefDto with SHA-256 checksum.

Add persistence and evidence integration to AcceptanceHarnessService:

1. Persist harness run records: Change generate_fixture to optionally create ArtifactMetadataModel-based run records (track fixture runs by dedicated run_id prefix 'harness-run-' instead of in-memory dict)

2. Wire new evidence methods: In generate_fixture, after fixture_manifest and isolation_evidence, also call:
   - record_source_integrity_proof() with pre/post generation checksum comparison

3. In evaluate_fixture, after integration_result and proof_report, also call:
   - record_output_fingerprint() with output dir contents and SHA-256

4. Add cancellation evidence: Add method _record_cancellation_for_run(run_id, fixture_id, reason) that records cancellation evidence using the new record_cancellation_evidence() method. Called from evaluate_fixture when the subprocess is cancelled/timeout.

5. Add repair lineage: Add method _record_repair_for_run(run_id, fixture_id, repair_results) that records repair lineage using record_repair_lineage(). Called after a failed fixture evaluation that triggers a repair attempt.

6. In run_acceptance_suite: After processing all fixtures, call:
   - record_acceptance_suite_evidence() with the full aggregate summary
   - The method now returns the full HarnessStatusDto with evidence_refs for the suite

7. Keep in-memory idempotency store as-is (Phase A placeholder). Add a docstring noting it will be replaced by StateTransitionService in Phase B.

8. Add new private method _compute_output_fingerprint(fixture_root) -> dict to compute SHA-256 fingerprint of all files in output directory.

Add evidence retrieval endpoints to the acceptance router:

1. GET /operator/acceptance-suite/runs
   - Query ArtifactMetadataModel for all entries with run_id LIKE 'harness-run-%'
   - Returns a list of unique run_ids with their latest evidence metadata
   - Response: list[dict] with run_id, fixture_count, status, latest_event, evidence_summary
   - Uses session_scope() directly (no service layer for simple queries)

2. GET /operator/acceptance-suite/runs/{run_id}
   - Returns full run details: all ArtifactRefDto entries associated with the run_id
   - Returns proof report and aggregate evidence as well
   - Response: HarnessStatusDto with all fixtures and evidence_refs populated from persisted data

3. GET /operator/acceptance-suite/runs/{run_id}/evidence
   - Returns all evidence artifact refs for a given harness run
   - Returns list[ArtifactRefDto] ordered by artifact_type
   - Note: Content retrieval is delegated to existing GET /migrations/{run_id}/artifacts/{path}

All endpoints include proper error handling (404 for unknown run_id, x-correlation-id in errors).

Create comprehensive test file for T02 components. Test groups:

(A) RuntimeEvidenceCollector new methods:
   - record_cancellation_evidence returns ArtifactRefDto with valid checksum
   - record_restart_evidence includes previous_state_version in payload
   - record_repair_lineage captures multiple repair attempts sequentially
   - record_output_fingerprint creates deterministic JSON with SHA-256
   - record_source_integrity_proof compares pre/post checksums
   - record_acceptance_suite_evidence contains aggregate fixture count

(B) AcceptanceHarnessService persistence:
   - generate_fixture now records source_integrity_proof evidence
   - evaluate_fixture records output_fingerprint evidence on success
   - Cancellation branch records cancellation_evidence
   - run_acceptance_suite records aggregate suite evidence
   - All evidence artifacts are retrievable via their ArtifactRefDto

(C) API endpoints:
   - GET /operator/acceptance-suite/runs returns 200 with list of run_ids
   - GET /operator/acceptance-suite/runs/{run_id} returns 200 with evidence refs
   - GET /operator/acceptance-suite/runs/{run_id} returns 404 for unknown run_id
   - GET /operator/acceptance-suite/runs/{run_id}/evidence returns sorted ArtifactRefDto list

(D) Event type consistency:
   - New WorkflowEventType entries are registered and serializable
   - HarnessRunStatusDto rejects unknown fields (extra='forbid' enforcement)

Uses tmp_path isolation, inline SQLite via session_scope with test settings, and LocalFilesystemArtifactStore with isolated root.

1. test_acceptance_event_types_in_openapi — asserts new WorkflowEventType entries appear in OpenAPI schema

risks.description: Phase A boundary violation — risk of inadvertently implementing G01–G09 production persistence in harness code (e.g., full StateTransitionService integration, MigrationRunModel creation for every fixture run)
risks.mitigation: T02 uses existing ArtifactMetadataModel exclusively (no new DB tables). AcceptanceHarnessService keeps in-memory idempotency for Phase A. StateTransitionService is consumed via fake adapters only. BLOCKED_INTEGRATION criteria explicitly documented.

risks.description: Evidence artifact bloat — each fixture run creates up to 9 evidence artifacts (fixture_manifest, isolation_evidence, output_layout, integration_result, proof_report, cancellation/restart, repair_lineage, output_fingerprint, source_integrity_proof). Runs with many fixtures could generate hundreds of files.
risks.mitigation: Use harness-specific run_id prefix for grouping. Each artifact is ~1KB JSON — overhead is minimal. The ARTIFACT_LAYOUT already supports cleanup by run_id. Add note about cleanup in Phase B.

risks.description: AcceptanceHarnessService still uses in-memory idempotency — run records are lost on service restart. Get /runs endpoint will only show runs from the current session.
risks.mitigation: Document that in-memory idempotency is Phase A only. Phase B will replace with StateTransitionService + MigrationRunModel. The evidence files themselves persist on disk regardless.

risks.description: Cancellation evidence requires reliable subprocess cancellation detection — the current ExecutionWorker returns CANCELLED status only if cancellation_policy is respected; otherwise the process may hang.
risks.mitigation: Use CancellationPolicy.TERMINATE_PROCESS_TREE for all harness profiles. Cancellable fixture includes deterministic timeout. Evidence is recorded only after confirmed cancellation (exit status or timeout).

risks.description: Output fingerprint will fail if build output directory doesn't exist (e.g., fixture not evaluated yet or ng build failed).
risks.mitigation: record_output_fingerprint handles missing directory gracefully: returns a fingerprint with {fingerprint: null, reason: 'output directory not found'}. AcceptanceHarnessService only calls after successful ng build.

risks.description: HarnessRunStatusDto changes may conflict with frontend consumers (S4-F15-I03).
risks.mitigation: HarnessRunStatusDto is a new DTO not consumed by existing frontend components. S4-F15-I03 will consume it in Phase A separately. Backward-compatible addition.
